items.question: Can I cancel at any time?
items.answer: Yes. The monthly plan has no commitment: you keep your benefits until the end of the current period.

items.question: What happens to my skins if I cancel?
items.answer: Items bought with your coins stay yours. Only subscriber-exclusive skins can no longer be equipped.

items.question: Does a subscription give an in-game advantage?
items.answer: No. Physics and rules are the same for everyone. Plans bring rewards, stats and cosmetics, never gameplay bonuses.

items.question: How does yearly billing work?
items.answer: You pay once a year and save the equivalent of two months compared with the monthly plan.
